body:
Fix pass complete on main; verification evidence below.

**Step 1 — deploy parity.** Deployed HEAD is `bd7c7ee` (from /__commit.txt, checked this run). It is an ancestor of the merge-gate chain (90fb6be → 30a5b95 → 89dccd5 → fb9fd4f → 8b19ee8), so the extension is NOT yet on the live surface. Per the brief's own instruction the remaining gap is the DevOps parity path (REEA-314 / REEA-302 pattern): once main deploys, QA re-verifies against deployed HEAD and closes REEA-316 + REEA-280 together with the audit numbers below.

**Step 2-3 — merged Scope II X card (fix: fb9fd4f + 8b19ee8).** Cluster key broadened per REEA-280 direction: Jarir-style spec-tail words (switch/ghz/rf/for/or/later/cpu/desktop/computer/windows, incl. joined forms via noised()) and the ROG sub-brand restatement now ride the NOISE class; `+` joined to the separator class. Live pipeline evidence (collectLiveResults against the real retailer answers): query `ASUS ROG Strix Scope II X` → ONE merged card, offers ascending: Blink 37.5 KWD first, Xcite 37.9 (was 40.9), Quadra Stores 37.9, Jarir SAR 499, Amazon.eg last. All four retailers present, none silently absent, cheapest visible/top. Nuance: under the REEA-192 contract one best row per retailer survives the fold, so Blink shows its 37.5; the 39.5 RX sibling folds into the same card rather than forming a tail row.

**Step 4 — guardrail.** `ASUS ROG Strix Scope II 96 Wireless` keeps its own cards live (X901/II 96/II 96 RX each with their own offers); ii ≠ ii96 token equality keeps the family separate from Scope II X; black ≠ white key separation pinned in tests.

**Step 5 — iPad Air.** Regression test pins: spelling variants (Wi-Fi vs Wi-Fi Cellular vs quoted size vs Apple-Intelligence tail) share the 256GB card across all three retailers; the 512GB tier keeps its own card.

**REA-280 AC audit (20-query live audit).** 1,677 raw retailer listings folded into 390 cards = 76.7% aggregate duplicate-card reduction. High-coverage classes clear the bar comfortably: iPad Air 86%, Xiaomi 15 / Microsoft Surface Laptop 83%, Pixel 9a 80%. Lowest figures are queries whose retailers genuinely carry distinct SKUs (Samsung U8000F sizes, Hisense model splits) — those stay separate cards per the AC. Note: card counts are capped at LIVE_SEARCH_MAX_PRODUCTS=20, which bounds the measured fold on high-volume queries. Storage/color tier separation held on all 20 queries.

Suite: 376 tests green (incl. the new end-to-end pipeline regression src/lib/collect/reaa316-merge.test.ts). Deploy remains with DevOps; final against-deployed-HEAD check closes REEA-316 + REEA-280 together.
